name: Room Assignment Validity - Room Is Active
natural_language: A reservation must not be assigned to a room that is out of service on the stay dates.

population.description: Non-cancelled reservations with an assigned room arriving from today onward, joined to rooms that have a closed window set.

predicates.note: Violation when the arrival falls inside the room's out-of-service window. v1 expressed this as `within` over a value object and never implemented the operator, so every record came back UNKNOWN (F2).

fallback.rationale: a room can be taken out of service without any reservation event being emitted - this is the doc's Type C case

execution.rationale: Type A where possible, Type C underneath. Unlike 1a-1c the ROOM side can change silently, so periodic re-checking is mandatory, not just a fallback.

freshness_requirement.rationale: Guest-facing: an arriving guest sent to an unusable room is an immediate operational failure.

unknown_conditions.when: room.closed_from or room.closed_to is populated but does not parse as yyyyMMdd
unknown_conditions.reason: the date format is assumed from documentation and has never been observed; a misparse would silently PASS

caveats: UNPROVEN. All 28 sandbox rooms return both closed-date fields empty, so this assertion has never executed against real data.
Only ONE closed window per room is representable (confirmed structurally - the field is not inside an ArrayOf wrapper). A PASS therefore means 'no evidence of closure', not 'proven open'.
